clips.quote: The foundation models and AI models aren't quite looking at the entire tree of life, and they're not going to magically overnight give us a genome and give us an answer.
clips.speaker: Ben Lamm

clips.text: The three animals produced by Colossal are not dire wolves.

clips.text: Our animals are grey wolves with 20 edits that are cloned.
clips.credit: Beth Shapiro, Chief Science Officer, Colossal · to New Scientist, May 2025
